verdict.rationale: A state business-filing registry could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a web portal (bizfile), mail and in-person filing, and bulk data files. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and nothing in the pack documents a versioned API or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
